design.transaction_boundary: Python owns research operation ports; ASP.NET owns identity/session ports; no competing production in-memory job store. P03 supplies durable research adapters.
design.idempotency_and_recovery: Forward exact request/receipt/revision without BFF duplicate lifecycle. Fake provider is permitted only inside test host with isolated fixtures; ordinary startup missing persistence returns dependency-not-ready.
design.error_and_unknown_semantics: UI renders unavailable/stale/pending/failed distinctly. Test fixture success cannot appear as production research success; server rejects broker/LIVE mode.
compatibility_rules: Use generated BFF/Python DTOs and exact CSRF/cookie/internal-service boundaries.
No direct browser Python/DB access, no duplicated quant or recovery implementation.
P02 contract-harness journey is not J1/J2 release acceptance; P03/P04 supply usable durable research.

Build/test-host contract owner: docs/architecture/V1_APPLICATION_BUILD_TESTHOST.md; exact transitive locks are first authorized implementation outputs, replay must be locked. Test stores cannot activate through ordinary runtime settings.

parallel_or_parked_work: P01 data qualification is independent; P03 durable jobs follows this application boundary.

positive_examples: U01 browser selects fixture dataset/strategy, submits test-host job, polls and renders published fixture result
U02 session expiry transitions UI to login without losing server operation reference
U03 production-mode missing durable provider reports 503 and degraded status
counterexamples: U04 spoofed actor header and missing login CSRF rejected
U05 cookie-only call to Python rejected
U06 test provider cannot activate under ordinary startup
U07 mutation timeout preserves key and expected revision
integration_tests: Playwright workspace contract suite via tests/browser/playwright.config.ts against isolated test host
regression_impact_set: API examples/error mapping/auth boundary; no product quant regression unless shared contract changes are explicitly authorized
independent_review_scope: test-only provider isolation and no fake runtime authority
usable browser error and asynchronous workflow

acceptance_checks: U01-U08 exact test/browser evidence plus reviewed builds
No real PG/broker credentials or production activation
Durable jobs not claimed complete; J1/J2 not credited by harness
Windows-x64 and Linux-glibc-x64 build/test evidence with exact tool/lock hashes; no claim for untested lanes
Ordinary published artifact excludes test hosts/providers and cannot activate fixtures through config/header input
stop_conditions: P00 baseline not independently accepted or exact package grant missing
Test adapter can be enabled in ordinary deployment
Dependency family/source or OS/architecture outside the frozen build-profile policy requires amendment; no global install without authorization
API/public domain semantics change needs Architect amendment
